main_text.p: næ, cuius intuitu pudeat in posterum ἐπεξαγωγίζειν[?] eos qui de rebus verè ni-hili

p.i: Et spirant tragicum, satis & feliciter audent.

main_text.p: Quòd si forte hæc fabula suam nondū periodum assecuta fuerit, præludium saltem habeatur hoc, ad iustū finem & perfectā adusque determinationē.
main_text.head: ¶ Dipnosophistica vox quàm sit conveniens præsenti tragœdiæ.
main_text.p: INCIDI nuper in libellum Δειπνολογικὸν[?], cuiº[?] auctor, cùm sibi propositisset quæstionē simplicem de cœna Domini, ad categorias, tanquam ad fontes rerum, deducendam, (egregio sanè conatu, si tā ingenuè ad veritatem pervestigandā, quàm assentatoriè ad auram popularem captandā, & ad invidiam aliis concitandam, suum institutum velut mantelum expassum flexisset) invehitur aliquoties acerbius & contumeliosius in Dipnosophistas: eos videlicet hac nota designans qui in negotio Eucharistico spiri-

page.notes: Greek words in the first line and in the opening word of the paragraph (ἐπεξαγωγίζειν, Δειπνολογικὸν) are uncertain in their exact letters and accents. "cuiº" is printed with a superscript sign after "cui", read as cuius; uncertain. The page is otherwise clear. No catchword or signature is printed. The large initial I of "INCIDI" is a woodcut initial joined to the small capitals.
